purpose: Evaluate whether distinct OCID physical-instance proxies selected by the author can form anonymous recurring visual types from persisted predicted-mask DINOv2 embeddings.

label_semantics.source_label: A sequence-local OCID physical-instance proxy used only by evaluation.
label_semantics.author_visual_type: A predeclared appearance-level hypothesis, not OCID ground truth and not a semantic class.
label_semantics.paired_camera_policy: Bottom and top are evaluated independently as two views of one physical scene and do not count as independent physical-instance pairs.
label_semantics.packaging_policy: Shared product purpose such as cereal or porridge packaging is insufficient for one visual type when color and internal visual structure differ strongly.

evaluation_policy.case_pass_rule: Both directed queries rank the declared counterpart first and both counterpart-minus-hardest-other margins are strictly positive.
evaluation_policy.hard_negative_rule: The declared positive prototype similarity must be strictly greater than both similarities from the explicit hard-negative instance to the two positive members.
evaluation_policy.threshold_policy: Do not fit or select a production visual-type threshold. Report the frozen 0.80 gate and the observed positive-versus-competitor separation interval as diagnostics only.
evaluation_policy.uncertain_policy: Uncertain diagnostics never affect support status and must not be relabelled from model scores.
evaluation_policy.challenge_policy: Challenge positives are reported separately and never affect the primary support rule.
evaluation_policy.false_positive_policy: Detector false positives do not create physical-instance prototypes but remain an extractor limitation.
evaluation_policy.ground_truth_boundary: Reviewed labels are opened only after the persisted development-only Gate C2 inference manifest and hashes are validated.

hypotheses.description: Two marker pens with close appearance.
Two pliers differing mainly by position and apparent size.
Two visually close apricot or nectarine instances.
Two markers with different color, orientation and visible side.
Appearance-level similarity is plausible but not asserted as ground truth by the author.
Same-shape LEGO parts with different color and position; possible shared base type with different color subtypes.

hard_negative_checks.description: Apple label 006 is a visually close near-negative but differs in color and internal appearance.
Paired-camera replication of the apple near-negative check.

excluded_claims: The experiment establishes a universal visual-type taxonomy.
The experiment establishes semantic object classes or names.
Top and bottom views are independent physical-instance examples.
A production threshold is calibrated by this development-only experiment.
Uncertain diagnostics become positives when the model gives them a high score.
Held-out data is opened, embedded, visualized or evaluated.
